brief.description: Concise Chinese description of visible subject, action or state, and scene.

elements.description: Searchable Chinese noun phrases for visible static subjects, clothing, props, and scene objects.

use.description: Concise Chinese note describing the image's practical reference use.

key.description: Visible visual hook followed by its concrete reference value.

camera.description: Visible shot size, angle, framing, perspective, lens feel, and scale.

light_color.description: Visible lighting and color relationships described as one visual system.

suggest_title.description: Searchable replacement title only when the original title is generic or meaningless; empty string preserves it.

tags.description: Exact tags selected from the supplied taxonomy.

use_intents.description: Exact internal use-intent identifiers selected from the supplied list.

visible_text.description: Exact text legible in the image; empty array if none.

brand_evidence.description: Identifiable visible brand marks and their locations; empty array if none.

product_categories.description: Generic product categories identifiable in the image; empty array if none.

commercial_format_confidence.description: Confidence that the commercial format is supported by visible evidence and context.
